notes.title: Chill the Piro Update 2.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24529644/9ab58b4eb9d77091079c85fc8b72cccd13e7c988.png[/img]

In new version:

1. Changed the design of the menu, screens and game interface in the direction of greater clarity.
2. Information about how to play (some tutorials) we placed at the start of the first levels.
3. At the beginning of each level added a description of what to do (to meet the time, to put out all the fires and etc).
4. A little simplified initial levels.
5. In the mini-game switch direction of the dwellers initiated by click on them.
6. Cleaned the levels from unnecessary game elements.
7. Fixed other minor bugs.

Thanks for your attention. :piro:
